2023 / Contribution

Getting started with Tailcall

Finding a project through Hacktoberfest, then staying to work on its runtime.

I started contributing to Tailcall in 2023 after finding it through Hacktoberfest. It became an opportunity to work on a larger Rust codebase and learn how a GraphQL runtime fits together.

That was the beginning of a longer stretch of work on the project. In 2024, I went on to work on WebAssembly support, runtime abstractions, gRPC, and query execution.
